# Calibration report

Four player types on seeds 1 to 100, and 1000 random playthroughs on seeds 1 to 1000. Every run goes to month 40 so every callback lands. Checkpoints read at the end of months 21 and 24.

## Section 13 targets, judged against the player types

The player types are the primary result. Random play is not a model of a human player: it takes the expensive option at D02, D10, D19 and D23 about two times in three, so its percentiles describe the spread of outcomes, not how people play. They follow as a secondary measure.

Weak play is judged against Spender, the median against Balanced and Cautious, strong play against Maximum saving (maths doc section 13). Each figure is the type's median over seeds 1 to 100.

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Month 21 net worth | Negative to 50k | -3,29,334 (in range) | 2.5L | 2,68,239 | 3,71,138 | in range | 6L | 5,15,966 (in range) |
| Month 21 Safety | 30 | 30.0 (in range) | 73 | 56.3 | 100.0 | below | 100 | 100.0 (in range) |
| Month 24 net worth | under -65k | -5,26,674 (in range) | 1.7L | 2,13,440 | 3,48,027 | above | 5.4L | 5,98,969 (in range) |
| Month 24 Safety | 30 | 30.0 (in range) | 47 | 35.2 | 100.0 | below | 74 | 95.8 (above) |
| Month 120 net worth | 8L | Needs Chapters 2 to 6 | 45L | Needs Chapters 2 to 6 | Needs Chapters 2 to 6 | . | 1.2Cr | Needs Chapters 2 to 6 |
| Month 240 net worth | 25L | Needs Chapters 2 to 6 | 2.2Cr | Needs Chapters 2 to 6 | Needs Chapters 2 to 6 | . | 6Cr | Needs Chapters 2 to 6 |

"In range" for a single-value target means within 20% of it. "Under X" and "negative to X" targets are in range below X. For net worth the median target is "bracketed" when it lies between Balanced and Cautious; otherwise it takes the nearer type's verdict, or "in range" if either type is. For Safety the median is Balanced's verdict alone, since Cautious holds full runway and reads 100 by definition.
